title: Docs portal: a section cross-link through a flat permalink loses its #fragment on the redirect, so the doc opens at the top
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw6yXcLi9aRRBpPT4W

QA-source: #33048 · platform-core.docs-portal-render · observed beside the clauses

## Reproduction (stock showcase @ ee9ad834)
1. Open `/_console/docs/manual/showcase_index`.
2. Click the "cross-reference section" link (href `/_console/docs/showcase_docs_guide#cross-references`, a flat permalink with a fragment).
3. Final URL: `/_console/docs/manual/showcase_docs_guide` with no `#cross-references`; the page renders at its top.

Expected: the flat → canonical redirect keeps the fragment and the page scrolls to the section.

Low severity.
